calculation.expression: -(sum_{k=0..2}(r_asset[t-k]-median_cross_section(r[t-k]))) when lagged cross-sectional daily return dispersion exceeds its trailing 90-day 75th percentile; cross-sectional demean
calculation.description: Contrarian residual-return signal activated after unusually high cross-asset dispersion. The common cross-sectional move is removed before measuring the three-day reversal. Signal uses only information available through t-1 for forward-return testing.

validation.regime_notes: Three-day paper IC/ICIR pass the benchmark gates. One-day and five-day IC were +0.018422/+0.034108 with ICIR +0.046622/+0.089512. The three-day activation sample is sparse and regime dependent: 2020-2022 IC -0.061366, 2023-2024 +0.014151, 2025-2026 +0.085889, online 2026-07-16 through 2027-02-25 +0.061903 (ICIR +0.167277). Treat coverage and regime concentration as risks.
